verdict.rationale: mParticle now ships AI features (an agent and recommendations), so whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair question. The pack documents only GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-out controls, which govern forwarding to downstream partners. These are adjacent privacy controls, not a policy or setting that stops customer data from training AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
